correctness.rationale: From CTMC first-event conditioning in states (susceptible S, infectious I), with removals monotone, the success probability F(S,I) obeys a well-founded rational recurrence: terminal |I|≥k success and I=∅ failure; each infection/rate term and removal/rate term normalized by |I|+β∑d_I(v). The denominator is positive for I≠∅, recursive measure 2|S|+|I| strictly decreases. Independent graph-atlas census checked all connected graph isomorphism types n=2..5 (1,2,6,21), all missing edges, seeds, k, and the rational differences for all β>0: exactly 1,738 comparisons (1,475 with nonnegative numerator+denominator polynomial coefficients and positive sign; 263 identities). Exact independent six-vertex subset DP for β=50 proves R6(tree)-R6(+edge)=24352320312500/56704429847324259>0 with stated graph, seed1. Thus six vertices are sharp; no small-n numerical sampling is used to claim all β.
residual_risks: Positivity-by-coefficients applies to the specific completely enumerated set n≤5; no claim for all larger graphs or all β in the six-vertex witness.

evidence: Different earlier claims concern duration, seed rankings, other event thresholds; none supplies edge-addition monotonicity over all k and rates in the same peak-hitting metric.

No published Resultary search record supplied the all-rate edge-addition monotonicity through five and sharp six-vertex SIR peak-overload counterexample under identical CTMC and single-seed conventions.

value.rationale: A sharp failure of contact-addition monotonicity for *realized peak concurrent overload* is a structural counterexample with an exact first-order size cutoff under fixed natural homogeneous CTMC rules. Unlike routine average-final-size computations, the 1738 full-parameter rational classifications distinguish n≤5 from n=6, and the rational six-vertex witness gives a reproducible overload-risk design boundary.
residual_risks: The negative effect for the exhibited β is small (~0.00042946) and is not epidemiological policy advice.

limitations: Finite connected undirected unweighted graphs, single infectious seed, homogeneous recovery=1 and transmission β, peak threshold k≥2; no assertion about heterogeneous networks.
No full source census beyond n=5; the witness only needs one n=6 graph and β=50.
